verdict.rationale: DBOS documents automatic checkpointing and recovery of workflows/steps from failure without manual try/catch scaffolding (dbos-docs-3, dbos-docs-4, dbos-comm-13), and this is corroborated by community reports of durable, exactly-once step execution (dbos-comm-2, dbos-comm-15). However, the evidence pack never shows explicit configuration knobs for per-step backoff schedules, timeouts, or custom failure policies — only that failed workflows resume from the last completed step. missing for 10: explicit docs/examples of configurable retry backoff intervals, step-level timeout settings, and custom failure-policy configuration (e.g. max attempts, exponential backoff parameters) beyond generic crash-recovery behavior.
